newsitem.title: USA: Food Court completes $7.8 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: Food Court completes $7.8 mln offering.

text.p: Food Court Entertainment Network Inc said it completed a private placement of securities to accredited investors which provided the company with an additional $7.8 million in expansion and working capital.

The company said proceeds would be used to expand Food Court's Cafe USA installations, provide funding for operations and develop new digital technology for transmitting programming to the Cafe USA network.
D.H. Blair Investment Banking Corp served as underwriter of the offering.
